sources.citation: Ivanow, W. 1931. The Dialect of Gozärkhon in Alamut. Acta Orientalia 9: 352-369.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: online with a university library login: DDO JOURNALS PJ1.A4; HYL (W) PJ1.A4; WID Old Widener OL 1.10 (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.harvard_location: DDO JOURNALS PJ1.A4; HYL (W) PJ1.A4; WID Old Widener OL 1.10
sources.note: '1. Notes on Phonology' (pp. 357-359) covers vowels, consonants and correspondences with Literary Persian and says nothing about word stress. The only accent remark is p. 362, on the substantive verb: 'it is always pronounced not dorä, as one would expect, but as dárä, with the accent on the first syllable' (paradigm dáräm, dári, dárä; dárim, dárin, dáren) - a note on one form, not a general rule; the expected default is not stated. Page image of p. 362 viewed to confirm the acute on dárä.
